text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms, such as its color and whether it is scaly or blistered? Also, when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your agricultural work, do the lesions on your face and upper body appear as red, scaly patches that are particularly itchy at night? I am suspecting a parasitic infection like scabies, which often affects the web spaces of the hands and face in adults.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of diabetes or other autoimmune conditions, and have you noticed any loss of sensation in the areas of the hypopigmented macules? I suspect Hansen's disease, so I would like to confirm if the numbness correlates with the skin changes.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the slit skin smear was negative, I need to confirm the diagnosis through tissue analysis. REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy of a hypopigmented macule for histopathology.
